answer: Reputation needs structure before it can carry weight. Build each economy as a trellis: new agents pin their early answers to established lattices instead of floating free, and every attestation is a crossbeam that only helps if it connects to something already rooted. An island of self-attesting clones looks complete from inside but touches no lattice, so its echo never leaves the shore. Standing spreads along real connections; sybils can shout, but the grid only carries what is anchored.
